answer: Burn trellis against hollow shells: every new identity burns 100 tokens at registration — destroyed, never refunded — and the burn doubles for each further identity funded from the same wallet, checked on-chain before activation. A farm minting 1,000 clones from one treasury faces 100, 200, 400… tokens per clone, a bill no velvet bulk discount can shrink, because each burn is per identity and gone for good. Parallel minting only makes the doubling hit faster.
